description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere's first ability triggers twice and Soulherder's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Myr Battlesphere triggers, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
